Supply List

Please send the following in with your student on the first day.

• Two composition notebooks
• One pack of #2 pencils
• Headphones (labeled with your child’s name)
- A refillable water bottle
* Optional: tissues for the classroom

 

Drop-off order

1. Check in at the front office
2. Meet your teacher in the classroom
3. Drop supplies at the labeled bins

a) Kindergarten uses the side entrance
b) Grades 1–5 use the main doors

Thanks — we cannot wait to see everyone.
